comment: A sketch region's notice in a moved component (mitcad#1609), tools/ui-notice-places-test.sh: Part:1 (O1) placed 100 mm along x; its Sketch1 (F1) a 60 x 40 rectangle about its own origin, extruded 10 (Plate, F2.b0); a line then drawn across the rectangle splits the extruded region in two, which Plate finds again and warns about, the region the place of its notice (x -30 to 30 in the component, 70 to 130 as the occurrence shows it).
